1 # Scope of this Git publication
   2 
   3 This is an **incomplete remediation handoff**, not a release, a fresh audit of
   4 the whole source, or permission to run the archived validation programs.
   5 
   6 ## What the upload is intended to preserve
   7 
   8 - The exact G12 application snapshot: 811 source members and all 122 changed-file
   9   after-images, permanent regression tests included. Git storage normalization
  10   and the two declared PowerShell checkout-EOL differences are separately bound
  11   by `SOURCE-GIT-INDEX.json` and `../audit-handoff/current/source-transport.json`.
  12 - The frozen handoff package, `../audit-handoff/PACKAGE.json` (SHA256
  13   `bc4e7cc7d6ae83bedcec3b4947a14de2aac52706089af9e2abbc2564c5f91a81`):
  14   171 members excluding the manifest itself. Supplemental publication receipts
  15   live in this directory so they do not rewrite that package.
  16 - Current issue/variant/status, suspicion, design-decision, verification and
  17   coverage ledgers; exact prior findings, patches, reviews and compact results.
  18   The evidence reader actually verified 21,378 indexed paths, 16,510 exact blobs
  19   and 11 packs. This is transport evidence, not 21,378 reviewed source files.
  20 - Explicit next steps and limitations. The 226 omitted paths remain described
  21   in `../audit-handoff/omissions.json`; do not infer that every historical record
  22   was uploaded. The reference inventory is a candidate locator, not complete
  23   semantic reference resolution: 109 unresolved/external and 31 policy-withheld
  24   path candidates with unresolved digests remain visible.
  25 
  26 ## Publication screening is bounded
  27 
  28 `DIRECT-PUBLICATION-SCREENING.json` records static signatures over the intended
  29 files at its capture time. It is not universal secret clearance. Non-UTF8 assets
  30 were not text-scanned; historical pack screening has its own receipts.
  31 
  32 The five specific flags in four source files were independently classified as
  33 deliberate synthetic test fixtures or runtime-input parser predicates. See
  34 `reviews/clone-handoff-marker-platform-v1/REPORT.md` and its exact file hashes.
  35 No source replacement was warranted for those exact contexts. No provider token
  36 authentication, real key parsing, scanner/test execution or blanket path allowlist
  37 was performed. Two web captures with embedded API-key-shaped data and all included
  38 aliases were omitted; that is not a general statement about every possible secret.
  39 
  40 ## Verification and command boundaries
  41 
  42 The seven local reader checks in `TRANSPORT-CHECKS.json` passed their respective
  43 positive or expected-rejection outcomes. They executed **zero application test
  44 cases**. Remote-clone evidence, when recorded, must identify its exact pushed
  45 commit and complete index manifest, not merely the branch name.
  46 
  47 New clone-helper source drafts and independent review are retained as inert text
  48 under `transport-helper/` and `reviews/`. V1 had actual source-level isolation and
  49 cleanup-accounting objections; V2 addressed them; V3 narrowed a documentation
  50 claim and uses its own one-shot journal namespace. Source acceptance is not
  51 proof that a clone command executed or that cleanup succeeded. Only actual run
  52 receipts can establish those observations. Do not replay these host-specific
  53 programs on another machine.
  54 
  55 Two additional metadata-display diagnostics failed on list-versus-dictionary
  56 assumptions; `RESUME-METADATA-DIAGNOSTICS.json` records both. They changed no source
  57 and ran no application tests. Neither is hidden as a successful check.
  58 
  59 No Gradle, Kotlin, Xcode or native build, application test or app launch was
  60 started for this publication. Therefore a new Gradle-stop invocation is not
  61 applicable, and no older CLOSED stop/recovery obligation is discharged. Only an
  62 explicitly created disposable Git-clone/environment root may be removed; the
  63 original checkout, remediation worktree, reports and shared caches are preserved.
  64 
  65 Only `codex/remediation-handoff-20260908` is an authorized push destination.
  66 The fifteen inspected workflow event blocks declare no automatic application
  67 build/publishing trigger for a push to this branch; that does not certify external
  68 integrations. No merge, main/testing/release movement, tag/version/build-number
  69 change, production signing, deployment approval, Store upload or app publication
  70 is intended. Existing candidate/build **1017001 remains separate and unchanged**.
  71 
  72 Progress is still **22/37 qualified confirmed-family closures (59.5%)**; the
  73 remaining fifteen are not converted into passes by committing this handoff.
